name: filesystem
description: Read, write, edit and search the agent's files in the task's sandbox, as tool calls rather than shell commands.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a text file, a window of lines at a time.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write text to a file, replacing it if it exists.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Replace an exact string in a file, refusing an ambiguous match.

tools.name: file_info
tools.description: Size, type and modification time of a path.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Find files whose name matches a glob, recursively.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Find lines matching a regular expression, recursively.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename a file or directory.

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Create a directory, including missing parents.
